ceramic.title: Handled pot with "luk" varnish. Three knobs on widest part.

A ceramic pot of red brown fabric, with an everted decorated in small grooves, convex top half, raised ridge around the middle, and rounded bottom half with a flat base. Two handles attached from the neck to mid section; one possibly incorporating a spout which is now blocked. Decorated with grooves and patterns in dark red slip.
Carinated jug with short spout and two handles. Decorated with panels of dark glaze and dark pink patterns; Dar, Thebana and Jerida (the horse, the fly and the palm leaf).

Wide dish on pedestal foot with hammerhead rim and pierced lug on rim. Decorated in six sections alternating between dark maroon slip and pale/dark pink patterns: Dar, Thebana and Jerida (the horse, the fly, the palm leaf).
Large two-handled pot with sharp carination. Internally glazed and decorated with bands of dark glaze and pink ornament: Dar, Thebana and Jerida (the horse, the fly and the palm leaf.
Carinated bowl with single handle supporting an upright projection. Interior and upper shoulder of bowl glazed with a deep red brown glaze and deeper linear decoration.

A ceramic pot with a wide mouth, upright rim, straight sides and a flat base, with a small handle attached to the rim and a raised ridge just below the rim. Inside covered in a dark red slip, outside a light orange colour with vertical red lines.
